steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Hey, sly fox, eyes over here! See what I got!
With a flourish, Pricilla presents an elegant white card before her partner. On its face is the stylized design of a red cat's head.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Ohhh? How did you know I got my hands on a little souvenir from the legendary phantom thief group "Cat's Eye"? Was my aura just that dazzling?

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: ...Who asked?

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Hmph, I knew you'd think it's some back-alley fake! Okay, fine, look closer!

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: See this embossing? And this ink, faded just so... Heh. No cheap knockoff gets these details right.
She smugly waves the little white card, loosening and tightening her grip as if deliberately teasing her partner.
She looks away, but her fingers pause unconsciously at her sleeve cuff.
Pricilla notices her partner's subtle movement all the same.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Oho?
Pricilla's grin broadens, and she edges closer to her partner's side.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Hehehe... That's the face! The "I'm secretly jealous but too proud to admit it" face!
Mid-sentence, she realizes her body feels impossibly heavy, as if filled with lead. Sensing something, she looks up at her partner beside her.
Only to find her own grin now sitting on her partner's face.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: How should I put this... Letting all that envy get to your head isn't exactly a good thing.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: You... with your dirty trick...
Casually, Fox plucks the card from her hand, then gives her partner a light pat on the cheek.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: Save your breath. This card is mine now.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Say it again... Whose card is it?

steps.content: A voice, flat and emotionless, reaches them. Though not loud, it carries a chill that can tighten the spine of any Sinner.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Pricilla. Did you take something from me again?

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Wha—?! N-no! Chief, I was just... borrowing it! Right—

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: I was totally gonna... return it when I was done! Seriously!

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Chief! Chief, wait, not the shackles! We can talk this through!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry. I'll make sure you're not alone.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: Hold on. I had no part in th—

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Heh! You're not wriggling out of this, you sly fox!
Seizing Tetra's moment of distraction, Pricilla breaks her hold. They are on the verge of clashing when you act.
In that instant, you release your shackles, winding them securely around both figures.
From the air, the white card with its red cat design drifts gently down, coming to rest once more in your open palm as though it had never been gone.
